mechanism: Lansoprazole inhibits CYP3A4, reducing dronedarone metabolism and increasing dronedarone plasma concentrations, while dronedarone may inhibit CYP2C19, potentially increasing lansoprazole levels.
action: Monitor for dronedarone toxicity (QT prolongation, bradycardia, gastrointestinal effects); consider alternative PPI or dose adjustment if feasible, and perform ECG monitoring.
